title: Playing in his mother's band as a boy
summary: From about age twelve he played in his mother's band alongside pros like Lorenzo Wardell and Alton Moore, and Handy's band would visit the house.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well, that was from around 12, 13. I was playing, you know, with her band then. And she had let's see one guy I remember particularly, his name was Lorenzo Wardell. He had played with let's see -- was it McKinney's cotton pickers? From Detroit. Yeah, a very fine -- but any way, he played in our band. And another guy who was a trombone player with Benny Carter was also in our band, his name was Alton Moore. And these were real pros. And Montgomery, Handy -- at this time Handy would do tours, also.
